pairs: Cumque cœperitis terram dividere sortito,
“And when you will begin to divide the land by lot,
separate primitias Domino, sanctificatum de terra,
separate as first-fruits for the Lord a sanctified portion of the land,
longitudine viginti quinque millia, et latitudine decem millia:
in length twenty-five thousand and in width ten thousand.
sanctificatum erit in omni termino ejus per circuitum.
It will be holy within all its borders all around.
Et erit ex omni parte sanctificatum quingentos per quingentos,
And there shall be, out of the entire region, a sanctified portion of five hundred by five hundred,
quadrifariam per circuitum,
foursquare all around,
et quinquaginta cubitis in suburbana ejus per gyrum.
with fifty cubits for its suburbs on all sides.
Et a mensura ista mensurabis longitudinem viginti quinque millium,
And with this measure,
et latitudinem decem millium:
you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand,
et in ipso erit templum,
and a width of ten thousand,
Sanctumque sanctorum.
and within it shall be the temple and the Holy of Holies.
Sanctificatum de terra erit sacerdotibus ministris sanctuarii,
The sanctified portion of the land shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary,
qui accedunt ad ministerium Domini:
who approach for the ministry of the Lord.
et erit eis locus in domos,
And it shall be a place for their houses,
et in sanctuarium sanctitatis.
and for the holy place of the sanctuary.
Viginti quinque autem millia longitudinis,
Now twenty-five thousand in length,
et decem millia latitudinis erunt Levitis qui ministrant domui:
and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, who minister in the house.
ipsi possidebunt viginti gazophylacia.
They shall possess twenty storerooms.
Et possessionem civitatis dabitis quinque millia latitudinis,
And you shall appoint a possession in the city of five thousand in width,
et longitudinis viginti quinque millia,
and twenty-five thousand in length,
secundum separationem sanctuarii,
in accord with the separation of the sanctuary,
omni domui Israël.
for the entire house of Israel.
Principi quoque hinc et inde in separationem sanctuarii,
Appoint the same for the prince, on one side and on the other, in the separation of the sanctuary,
et in possessionem civitatis,
and in the possession of the city,
contra faciem separationis sanctuarii,
opposite the face of the separation of the sanctuary,
et contra faciem possessionis urbis,
and opposite the face of the possession of the city,
a latere maris usque ad mare,
from the side of the sea even to the sea,
et a latere orientis usque ad orientem:
and from the side of the east even to the east.
longitudinis autem juxta unamquamque partem,
And the length shall be just as in each part,
a termino occidentali usque ad terminum orientalem.
from the western border even to the eastern border.
De terra erit ei possessio in Israël,
A portion of the land in Israel shall be for him.
et non depopulabuntur ultra principes populum meum:
And the princes shall no longer plunder my people. Instead,
sed terram dabunt domui Israël secundum tribus eorum.
they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
Hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
Thus says the Lord God:
Sufficiat vobis,
Let this be sufficient for you,
principes Israël:
O princes of Israel!
iniquitatem et rapinas intermittite,
Cease from iniquity and robberies,
et judicium et justitiam facite:
and execute judgment and justice.
separate confinia vestra a populo meo,
Separate your confines from my people,
ait Dominus Deus.
says the Lord God.
Statera justa,
You shall have just scales,
et ephi justum,
and a just unit of dry measure,
et batus justus erit vobis.
and a just unit of liquid measure.
Ephi et batus æqualia et unius mensuræ erunt,
The units of dry and liquid measure shall be one uniform measure,
ut capiat decimam partem cori batus,
so that a bath contains one tenth part of a cor,
et decimam partem cori ephi:
and an ephah contains one tenth part of a cor;
juxta mensuram cori erit æqua libratio eorum.
each shall be of equal volume in accord with the measure of a cor.
Siclus autem viginti obolos habet:
Now the shekel consists of twenty obols.
porro viginti sicli,
Furthermore,
et viginti quinque sicli,
twenty shekels,
et quindecim sicli,
and twenty-five shekels,
mnam faciunt.
and fifteen shekels makes one mina.
Et hæ sunt primitiæ quas tolletis:
And these are the first-fruits that you shall take:
sextam partem ephi de coro frumenti,
a sixth part of an ephah from each cor of wheat,
et sextam partem ephi de coro hordei.
and a sixth part of an ephah from each cor of barley.
Mensura quoque olei,
Likewise, a measure of oil,
batus olei,
a bath of oil,
decima pars cori est:
is one tenth part of a cor.
et decem bati corum faciunt,
And ten baths make one cor.
quia decem bati implent corum.
For ten baths complete one cor.
Et arietem unum de grege ducentorum,
And take one ram from each flock of two hundred,
de his quæ nutriunt Israël, in sacrificium, et in holocaustum,
out of those that Israel tends for sacrifice and holocausts and peace offerings,
et in pacifica, ad expiandum pro eis,
in order to make an expiation for them,
ait Dominus Deus.
says the Lord God.
Omnis populus terræ tenebitur primitiis his principi in Israël.
All the people of the land will take hold of these first-fruits for the prince in Israel.
Et super principem erunt holocausta,
And concerning the prince,
et sacrificium, et libamina, in solemnitatibus,
there shall be holocausts and sacrifice and libations,
et in calendis, et in sabbatis,
on solemnities and new moons and Sabbaths,
et in universis solemnitatibus domus Israël:
and on all the solemnities of the house of Israel.
ipse faciet pro peccato sacrificium,
He himself shall offer the sacrifice for sin,
et holocaustum,
and the holocaust,
et pacifica, ad expiandum pro domo Israël.
and the peace offerings, in order to make expiation for the house of Israel.
Hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
Thus says the Lord God:
In primo mense,
In the first month,
una mensis,
on the first of the month,
sumes vitulum de armento immaculatum,
you shall take an immaculate calf from the herd,
et expiabis sanctuarium.
and you shall expiate the sanctuary.
Et tollet sacerdos de sanguine quod erit pro peccato,
And the priest shall take from the blood that will be for the sin offering.
et ponet in postibus domus,
And he shall place it on the doorposts of the house,
et in quatuor angulis crepidinis altaris,
and on the four corners of the rim of the altar,
et in postibus portæ atrii interioris.
and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.
Et sic facies in septima mensis,
And so shall you do on the seventh day of the month,
pro unoquoque qui ignoravit,
on behalf of each one who was ignorant
et errore deceptus est:
or who was deceived by error.
et expiabis pro domo.
And you shall make expiation for the house.
In primo mense,
In the first month,
quartadecima die mensis,
the fourteenth day of the month shall be for you the solemnity of the Passover.
erit vobis Paschæ solemnitas:
For seven days,
septem diebus azyma comedentur.
unleavened bread shall be eaten.
Et faciet princeps in die illa,
And on that day,
pro se
the prince shall offer,
et pro universo populo terræ,
on behalf of himself and on behalf of all the people of the land,
vitulum pro peccato.
a calf for sin.
Et in septem dierum solemnitate faciet holocaustum Domino,
And during the solemnity of the seven days,
septem vitulos
he shall offer a holocaust to the Lord of seven immaculate calves and seven immaculate rams,
et septem arietes immaculatos,
daily for seven days,
quotidie septem diebus:
and a he-goat from among the she-goats,
et pro peccato hircum caprarum quotidie.
daily for sin.
Et sacrificium ephi per vitulum,
And he shall offer the sacrifice of an ephah for each calf,
et ephi per arietem faciet,
and an ephah for each ram,
et olei hin per singula ephi.
and a hin of oil for every ephah.
Septimo mense,
In the seventh month,
quintadecima die mensis,
on the fifteenth day of the month,
in solemnitate,
during the solemnities,
faciet sicut supra dicta sunt per septem dies,
he shall do just as was said above for the seven days,
tam pro peccato quam pro holocausto,
as much for the sin offering,
et in sacrificio, et in oleo.
as for the holocaust and sacrifice and oil.”
